subject: Deploy chronology and ephemeral key rotation walkthrough (SIG assessor request)
messages:

Cc: audit@veridianbank.com

Subject: SIG follow-up: deploy history + key rotation details

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Our SIG assessor asked for a concise deploy chronology for the last 12 months plus a walk-through of how ephemeral key rotations are performed and documented (including who initiates rotation, how pipeline runs are recorded, and artifact retention). Can you provide: 

- A csv or table with deploy timestamps, PR IDs, operator (service account or person), and associated pipeline run id.
- A short operational playbook (PDF preferred) describing the vault rotation steps we follow for ephemeral CI tokens and HSM-backed keys.
- Any log snapshots that show the pipeline invocation and the vault rotation event tied to an approval.

We need these for the assessor by EOD Friday. If parts of these need redaction, flag them and we will indicate to the assessor.

Best,
Sam Pratt
Senior IT Auditor
Veridian Bank

Sam —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can get a deliverable set together by Friday. Plan below:

1) deploy_chronology.csv — canonical extract from our deployment ledger (columns: deployed_at, commit_sha, pr_number, operator, pipeline_run_id, environment, rollback_ref). I'll redact committer emails and replace with role/service-account identifiers where required.

2) vault_rotation_playbook.pdf — step-by-step (operator and automation separation, approval gating, KMS/HSM callouts, sample CLI commands, and audit log pointers).

3) pipeline_snapshot.log — a short redacted log (30 lines) showing a rotation event initiated by CI and the corresponding approval signature.

Internal note: Karthik — can you confirm which rotation runs in the last 12 months were manual vs automated so I can tag the CSV? Marissa — I will need the playbook draft from you (CI vault integration and runbook) by Thu COB so I can compile and run a final redaction pass.

If you prefer a quick walkthrough call with the assessor, I'm available Thu afternoon.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: deploy history + key rotation details

Mina — quick answers below. I pulled the deploy ledger and annotated manually where necessary. Summary: 

- 14 rotations initiated in the last 12 months. 9 automated (scheduled workflows triggered by age policy), 5 manual (operator-initiated via the ops console).
- Automated rotations: executed by service-account:svc-ci-rotator; approval policy: auto-approve for staging, canary; production requires canary/owner signoff.
- Manual rotations: operator identity is tied to an SSO user; will replace exact email with role-based tags (e.g., "ops_oncall") in CSV extract.

I dropped a raw extract in our CSV export and flagged the manual runs with a note column. Point of caution: one manual rotation linked to a hotfix included ticket ID JIRA-8764 — we should redact ticket details if the assessor will see PII.

Attaching a quick pipeline_snapshot.log excerpt (redacted) — shows the rotation run and the call to KMS.

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot.log (see attached)

-Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2026 07:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: deploy history + key rotation details

Mina/Karthik — attached is the first draft of the vault rotation playbook. Highlights:

- Scope: CI ephemeral tokens, signing keys used by our runtime, and KMS/HSM-managed master keys.
- Roles: svc-ci-rotator (automation), ops_oncall (manual operator), security_owner (approval gate for production).
- Steps (short):
  1) Pre-rotation checks: run pipeline preflight, confirm no active long-running requests.
  2) Acquire lock in Vault (path: secret/locks/rotation/<key>)
  3) Create new key version via HSM API (or provision new ephemeral token for CI).
  4) Stage in canary environment and run smoke tests.
  5) Approval: security_owner or automated policy.
  6) Promote to prod and rotate consumer references.
  7) Post-rotation audit: commit summary to deploy ledger and emit rotation event (rotation:created) to observability.

I've intentionally left CLI snippets generic; if the assessor needs concrete commands we can produce a redacted appendix showing sample calls.

Attachments: vault_rotation_playbook.pdf

-Marissa Cole
Principal Cloud Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
